title: The bus that is always late

data.source: The driven rotor of MATHEMATICS.md R4 with its optional correlated force, three settings, 400 runs each.

prediction: The gap that covers a random moment has mean E[T^2]/E[T] in every case; the gaps are independent (a renewal process) only for a flat potential with fast noise, and are not for the printed cos-potential rotor or for slow noise.
baseline: Renewal theory: the inspection paradox and the alternating renewal process (Feller; Cox 1962).
why: All four predictions held. The list of cuts is a point process that renewal theory already describes. It is a plain renewal process only in one special case; CRR adds no number of its own here.
